roads.name: West Picture Rocks Road
words: Properly twisty: 12 curves in 2.0 miles, about 6 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 2,359 to 2,501 ft, with 405 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.42 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
